Let me look at the `read_rice_signed_block` function one more time. I think the OOB read is at line 867 when `cwords == words` and `br->bytes == 0`. But wait, if `br->bytes == 0`, then `br->consumed_bits` should also be 0 (since we can't have consumed bits from a non-existent tail word). So `br->buffer[cwords] << 0` is just `br->buffer[cwords]` which is `buffer[words]` - still within the allocated buffer.
